name: services_question_greeting
description: A new customer asks what the business does. Tests that the AI gives a concise overview of its products/services and then asks what the customer specifically needs.

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should include a greeting even though the customer did not greet first
Reply should describe what the business offers (boards, sheet materials, cutting services)
Reply should ask what the customer specifically needs

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: The AI should introduce itself and give a brief, friendly description of what HDS offers (e.g. melamine boards, sheet materials, cutting services), then ask the customer what they are looking for. It should not dump an exhaustive product catalogue or call any tools at this stage.
